run_profiler_context: run torch.autograd.profiler_legacy.profile as a context manager to profile PyTorch operations
export_chrome_trace_profile: export a legacy profiler result to Chrome trace JSON file for performance visualization
generate_profile_table: generate a formatted table of profiling results sorted by a specified metric
compute_key_averages: compute key averages of profiling events grouped by input shape or stack depth
get_total_average: get the total average timing across all profiling events
